phases.title: Survival
phases.goal: Handle greetings, introduce yourself, and get through basic daily situations with fixed phrases.
can: Use the present simple of 'be' (I am, you are, he is) to introduce yourself
Count from 0 to 20 and tell the time in whole hours
Ask and answer 'What's your name?' and 'How are you?'
Use the articles a/an and the with everyday nouns
Form simple yes/no questions with 'do/does' (Do you speak English?)
Order food and ask a price with 'I'd like...' and 'How much is...?'
phases.daily: 10 min learning greetings and numbers, 10 min repeating survival phrases aloud, 5 min labeling objects around you in English.

phases.title: Foundation
phases.goal: Talk about routines, the past, and plans using the three most common tenses.
can: Use the present simple vs present continuous (I work / I am working)
Form the past simple of regular verbs (-ed) and 20 key irregulars (went, saw, had)
Talk about the future with 'will' and 'going to'
Use prepositions of time at/in/on correctly
Make comparatives and superlatives (bigger, the biggest, more useful)
Use common modal verbs can, must, and should
phases.daily: 15 min on one tense with examples, 10 min drilling irregular past verbs, 10 min writing three sentences about your day.

phases.title: Core Structures
phases.goal: Connect ideas, describe experiences, and use the perfect and continuous tenses accurately.
can: Use the present perfect with since/for/just/already/yet
Contrast past simple and present perfect correctly
Build the passive voice (The book was written in 1984)
Use first and second conditionals for real and unreal situations
Add relative clauses with who/which/that
Choose correctly between gerunds and infinitives (enjoy swimming / want to go)
phases.daily: 20 min reading short graded texts, 10 min writing a paragraph using a target structure, 10 min listening and shadowing a podcast clip.

phases.title: Fluency
phases.goal: Speak and write at length with natural connectors, phrasal verbs, and reported speech.
can: Use the past continuous and past perfect to tell richer stories
Master 30+ common phrasal verbs (give up, look after, find out)
Report what others said with tense backshift (He said he was tired)
Use the present perfect continuous for duration (I've been working)
Handle question tags and indirect questions politely
Use although/despite and so that to link contrasting or purpose ideas
phases.daily: 20 min conversation or voice notes, 15 min learning phrasal verbs in context, 15 min consuming native content (shows, articles) with notes.

phases.title: Mastery
phases.goal: Use advanced grammar and idiom with precision, sounding natural in formal and informal registers.
can: Use third and mixed conditionals for hypothetical pasts (If I had known...)
Use future continuous and future perfect (I'll be flying / I will have graduated)
Handle causative have/get something done (I had my hair cut)
Express regret with wish and if only (I wish I had studied)
Make past deductions with must have / can't have / might have + participle
Switch smoothly between formal and casual registers and idioms
phases.daily: 30 min immersion in native media, 15 min writing formal and informal versions of the same message, 15 min discussing abstract topics with a partner or tutor.
